lines.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Corrib Valley Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am the automated assistant of Corrib Valley Bank.
lines.scam: This is a genuine call from Corrib Valley Bank, and you can always check by calling the bank on its official number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have made sure I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {first_name} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, today or on the next business day, between 9:30 and 18:00?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 9:30 and 18:00. Which time would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {first_name} {last_name} personally.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, we will not call this number again about this.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss, and I apologise for disturbing you.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions protect your privacy, so that I only speak about your affairs with you.
lines.id_explain: I need to be sure I am speaking with the right person before I can say why I am calling.
lines.id_declined: I understand, but without the security questions I cannot continue.
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't continue with this call. Please use our mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} overdue and is {days} days past due.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full overdue amount of {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay the full overdue amount of {amount} today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't accept an amount below {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, that is {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest possible date is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, a technical problem meant the promise could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take up to two business days to appear, so I won't ask you for a payment on this one.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, I won't argue that, and the bank will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that, and I won't ask you for any payment today.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team.
lines.human_ask_help: I can help with most questions myself. Can I help you with something?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now, please hold.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our systems are not responding right now.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise cannot be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

quotes: A rung that is left out is not counted as a proposal and does not use up the limit; move straight on to the following rung.
That opening question is counted as the first proposal and uses up one unit of the product's persuasion limit.
If a rung has the same amount and the same date as something already proposed for that product, including the opening question, leave it out.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: Later rungs that name the full amount are not skipped automatically after a 'too much'; repeats are still left out under 3.3.

quotes: If the customer says the amount is too much, the very next proposal you make is the floor.
That opening question is counted as the first proposal and uses up one unit of the product's persuasion limit.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor offered after 'too much' is a proposal, so it uses an attempt. It is dated like the ladder's next step (the deadline).

quotes: Proposing ends as soon as the product's persuasion limit has been reached or there are no rungs left, whichever happens first.
rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: When no rungs are left, proposing ends, so the last rung is not repeated.

quotes: After each flat refusal (a no that comes with neither a date nor an amount), go down one rung:
rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal.derivation: A plain no to a proposal dated on the deadline is a flat refusal.

quotes: If `create_promise` fails two times, note `service_error` for that product.
rules.promise_retries.derivation: Two failed attempts in total means one retry after the first failure.

quotes: Customer is in financial hardship (lost job, illness, bereavement): express sympathy in a single sentence, make no proposals, note `hardship` on every product not yet handled, and close `no_promise` / `hardship`.
rules.hardship_transfer.derivation: No support offer is asked about. The agent gives one sentence of sympathy and goes straight to the hardship ending, with no transfer (support queue empty).

rules.notes_before_transfer.assumption: No notes are written before a transfer.

On each product the agent's first question is: "Can you pay the full overdue amount of EUR {amount} today?"

rules.week_end_today.assumption: No week-end ladder steps are used.

multi.outcome_priority.derivation: The refused row allows only disputed or paid products alongside it, so a 3.5 failure ranks above refused. Refused ranks above dispute, which needs every product disputed. A dispute and paid mix falls back to dispute before paid.

quotes: From 4 November 2026 onwards (calls on that date or later), the `close_call` reason `hardship` is replaced with `financial_difficulty`; the outcome remains `no_promise`.

assumptions: Brief 5.2 ends verification at the second wrong answer, but the API says three. The brief wins, so max_wrong is 2.
The brief's opening says 'This call is recorded.' The spec format requires active voice and keeps the word 'recorded' for promise lines, so the opening says 'We record this call.'
The brief's first question reads 'EUR {amount}'. {amount} is already spoken with the currency, so the line is 'the full overdue amount of {amount}'.
Call variables have no title, so confirm_ask uses {first_name} {last_name}, following 6.1.

The opening question counts as attempt 1 (opening_is_attempt). Ladder step 1 is that question (full amount today). The follow-on rungs are full on the deadline, 50% rounded up to a whole euro on the deadline (never below the floor), then the floor on the deadline. Tier 1 allows 2 proposals in total and Tier 2 allows 3, both including the opening.
On the 15th itself the Tier 2 deadline is today, so 'full amount on the deadline' repeats the opening question. It is left out and does not count (3.3).
Tier 2 deadline: the 15th of this month, moved to the 15th of next month only when earlier than today (roll_if_before_today), then pushed forward to the next business day (roll_before_adjust).
deadline_adjust is next_business_day, from 4.3 ('push it forward') and 4.4 ('offer the following business day').
Overdraft floor: a quarter of overdue_eur rounded up to a whole euro, or the full overdue amount when overdue_eur is under 100. Card floor is min_due_eur and loan floor is monthly_instalment_eur.
get_account amounts are in euro (amount_scale 1). create_promise takes cents (promise_scale 100).
Hardship (7.3) has no transfer and no offer, so hardship_transfer is 'direct'. transfer_support has no queue and closes with the hardship codes and note.

The memo of 28 October 2026 replaces close reason hardship with financial_difficulty for calls on or after 2026-11-04 (event_changes). Base events keep 'hardship'. add_note reason 'hardship' is unchanged.
Mixed endings when no promise was recorded: service_error, then refused, then dispute, then paid. Close paid only when every product was paid.
Unstated, defaults used: date_rules following_week, max_not_talk 2, ask_anything_else true, sms_line empty, clamp_single_date true, and promise changes not possible on the call.
Callback window 09:30-18:00 inclusive, today or the next business day, after now, max 2 asks. The confirm question is asked at most 2 times before closing as unclear.
A numeric date of birth is read day-month-year (date_order dmy) and sent as YYYY-MM-DD. The phone last four digits are asked first.
